notes: gUnk_08D640A4[RoomProps.doorsIdx] (0x08D640A4, 287 pointers) -> the room's progress checklist: the chests and doors that count for the area map, and the bit positions they own in the saved gVisitedDoors[doorsIdx] word.

gVisitedDoors[doorsIdx] (u16, saved in the world-props SRAM block, game/src/save.c): bit i = entry i done (chest collected / door used), bit 15 = room visited. The area map shows a room as completed when all chest bits are set.

The three walkers (sub_08002B30 / sub_08002BA8 / sub_08002C18) loop for(;;) until they find a matching entry and never test the terminator: a chest or door whose key is missing from its room's list hangs the game. An editor must keep exactly one tag-2 entry per logical door (559 in retail = the distinct (destRoom, destX, destY) triples among the 724 tag-3 door cells) and one tag-1 entry per chest object (84), chests first.
Retail: 643 entries, all stride 8, chests always the leading chestCount entries (286/286 lists), list length 0..11, terminator = 4 bytes {0, 0, 0xFF, 0xFF}.

records.description: Header of a room's progress checklist.

fields.name: entries
fields.description: Pointer to the tag-discriminated, self-striding entry array (progress_chest / progress_door), ended by a tag-0 entry.

fields.name: chestCount
fields.description: Number of leading entries that count toward room completion on the area map (= the chests). sub_08002AD0 popcounts that many low bits of gVisitedDoors; pause_area_map marks the room completed when the counts are equal.

evidence.data: equals the number of tag-1 entries in 287/287 lists: 0 (216), 1 (61), 2 (7), 3 (3); total 84 = chest objects

records.description: Tag 1: a treasure chest of this room, identified by its object-template position. CreateChest's collect path calls sub_08002B30(roomId, template x, template y) to set the entry's bit.

fields.name: chestX
fields.description: The chest object's template x (ObjectTemplate.x of the OBJ_SMALL_CHEST/OBJ_BIG_CHEST record in this room's object list).

records.description: Tag 2: one logical door of this room, identified by its EXIT (the destination triple of its tag-3 door cells, solidity_map.json). Door objects read the bit to show the door as explored (open mirror / no '?' marker) and Kirby's transition sets it.

fields.name: destRoom
fields.description: Destination room of the door = cell_record_door.destRoom.

fields.name: destX
fields.description: = cell_record_door.destX (arrival cell in the destination room, not the door's own position).
